**Best move:** Rxh2+

**Main line:** Rxh2+ Kxh2 Rh7+ Qh6+ Rxh6#

**Motif:** Attraction + Deflection

**Explanation:**
Your opponent's king was dangerously exposed after Rfe1. Rxh2+ forces the king forward where it cannot escape the attack from the f7 rook. After Kxh2, Rh7+ drives the queen into a back-rank trap. The queen must move to defend, but any queen move to the h-file (Qh6 or Qh5) allows Rxh6# mate. This pattern—sacrificing to remove a defender and force mate—occurs when the enemy king has no escape squares. Always look for sacrifices that strip away protection.
